How to play
CLASSIC: tap to fly through pipes. One life (ads off). Your score goes to the leaderboard. No coins are spent.
PVP 1 VS 1: pick a C stake, find an opponent. You get 5 seconds to decline. If nobody declines, C is taken and Player 1 flies, then Player 2. Higher score wins 90% of the bank. Closing the bot after start is a loss.
